backend/main.mo: Defines the main canister actor including user, provider, client, job, document, and engagement types plus storage and access control state.
backend/migration.mo: Provides a no-op migration function returning the previous actor state unchanged.
feature_evidence.json: Contains feature evidence entries mapping features to affected frontend files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Lists short summaries of various frontend files describing their responsibilities and recent feature-related updates.
frontend/index.css: Defines global Tailwind CSS variables, dark-mode overrides, and base element styling.
frontend/index.html: Main HTML entry for the PWA including manifest links, meta tags, and root mount point.
frontend/public/.well-known/ic-domains: Lists the verified domain for Internet Computer canister hosting.
frontend/public/manifest.webmanifest: Defines PWA manifest metadata including icons, theme colors, and app configuration.
frontend/public/offline.html: Offline fallback page with basic styling and a retry button for PWA usage.
frontend/public/sw.js: Service worker implementing precaching, offline fallback, cache cleanup, and selective request interception.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component handling routing, authentication, onboarding flow, service worker registration, and page rendering logic.
frontend/src/components/AppLayout.tsx: Wraps pages with header, footer, and support drawer while passing navigation and user role props.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton: Provides login/logout button using Internet Identity with loading states and error handling.
frontend/src/components/auth/RoleOnboard: Handles user role selection and submission with pending role persistence and UI cards for each role.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Renders footer with copyright, support trigger, and a link to caffeine.ai using the current hostname.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Displays logo, dynamic navigation based on user role, support trigger, and PWA install button with mobile menu support.
frontend/src/components/landing/DemoVide: Empty file with no implemented content.
frontend/src/components/landing/Platform: Fetches platform stats and animates client and provider counts with fallback minimum thresholds.
frontend/src/components/landing/RoleQuic: Offers quick role selection with login flow, pending role storage, and navigation for authenticated users.
frontend/src/components/landing/Testimon: Displays a testimonials grid with static client reviews and provider avatars.
frontend/src/components/landing/useLandi: Empty file with no implemented content.
frontend/src/components/location/Locatio: A form component for entering or auto-filling address and coordinates using browser geolocation.
frontend/src/components/messaging/Conver: A messaging UI that lets clients send, view, and refresh chat messages with a provider.
frontend/src/components/notifications/En: An auto-dismissing alert showing whether a provider is engaged or not with manual dismiss support.
frontend/src/components/payments/MpesaUn: A dialog managing M-Pesa payment flow including phone validation, STK initiation, polling, and success/error handling.
frontend/src/components/providers/Featur: Displays a provider avatar with fallback initials and size options, handling load errors.
Renders a grid of demo featured provider cards with avatars, ratings, and basic profile info.
frontend/src/components/providers/Provid: Provider avatar component showing profile image or initials in configurable sizes.
A provider profile card displaying avatar, verification status, location, rate, category, and rating.
Shows a modal preview of a provider with avatar, ratings, verification status, availability, and map/detail actions.
frontend/src/components/providers/Unlock: Displays a card explaining and charging a connection fee before unlocking provider contact details.
frontend/src/components/pwa/InstallPromp: Shows a PWA install banner with iOS-specific instructions and handles prompting or dismissing installation.
frontend/src/components/ratings/StarRati: Renders average rating with full, half, and empty stars and displays rating count.
Provides an interactive 1–5 star rating input with optional readonly mode.
frontend/src/components/support/SupportD: Provides a drawer containing customer support phone and email contact information.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and caches a backend actor tied to the current identity and refreshes dependent queries when it changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useCountUpOnVisible.t: Animates a number counting up when the referenced element becomes visible via IntersectionObserver.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Manages Internet Identity authentication, providing identity state, login, logout, and status handling via context.
frontend/src/hooks/usePWAInstallPrompt.t: React hook that manages PWA install prompts, installation state, and iOS detection.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Collection of React Query hooks for fetching and mutating user, provider, and search data via the backend actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS setup defining global theme variables and styles, including light/dark modes and landing page backgrounds.
frontend/src/lib/categories.ts: Defines service categories with labels, business types, and icons for provider classification.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that initializes React, React Query, and Internet Identity provider before rendering App.
frontend/src/pages/backoffice/Verificati: Admin page for reviewing providers and updating their verification status with dialog-based approval or rejection.
frontend/src/pages/client/CategoriesPage: Displays all service categories with a search filter and navigates to results when a category is selected.
frontend/src/pages/client/MapViewPage.ts: Shows providers on a map or a placeholder if maps are unavailable, with navigation back to results and provider detail links.
frontend/src/pages/client/MyJobsPage.tsx: Lists the user's jobs, allows cancelling or completing jobs with ratings, and handles loading and empty states.
frontend/src/pages/client/ProviderDetail: Displays full provider details with ratings, unlock/payment flow, engagement updates, and job request messaging.
frontend/src/pages/client/ProviderResult: Shows providers in a selected category with search, preview dialogs, engagement notifications, and navigation to detail or map view.
frontend/src/pages/LandingPage.tsx: Landing page with hero section, authentication actions, and navigation to key feature sections.
frontend/src/pages/provider/ProviderProf: Allows providers to create or edit their profile, upload a picture, select a category, and set rates and location.
frontend/src/pages/provider/Verification: Provider page for viewing verification status and uploading academic and conduct documents with progress tracking.
frontend/src/utils/fees.ts: Utility functions to compute a 10% connection fee and format KES currency values.
Stores, retrieves, and clears a pending user role in sessionStorage with validation.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Helpers for reading URL parameters, persisting them in sessionStorage, and cleaning them from the URL/hash.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining theme extensions, colors, fonts, container settings, and plugins.
project_state.json: Project metadata describing the app direction, architecture notes, issues, and existing features.
